Container.Name: HomeInventory
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted home inventory system with AI image recognition, receipt scanning, mobile app sync, QR/NFC labels, warranty tracking, and insurance reports.
REQUIRES A POSTGRESQL 16 DATABASE. Install the official PostgreSQL 16 container from Community Applications first, create a database, then put its connection string in the Database URL field below. This container does not run its own database, so it maps no database path.
AI FEATURES ARE OPTIONAL AND RUN ON THE CPU. If you have no Ollama container, leave the AI Enabled field set to false. The inventory works without it. If you do run Ollama, pull a small vision model first: "ollama pull moondream". Larger models such as llava:7b take one to two minutes per image on a CPU.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: The port that the web interface and the API listen on.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Scheduled backup archives are written here.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Application settings that the web interface writes.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: The PostgreSQL 16 connection string. Use the IP address of your PostgreSQL container, not localhost.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Signs the login tokens. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: AI Enabled
Config.Description: Set to true only if you run an Ollama container. The inventory works without it.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: The address of your Ollama container.

Config.Name: Vision Model
Config.Description: Identifies items in a photograph. This server has no GPU, so moondream (1.8B) is the default. llava-phi3 is more accurate and slower.

Config.Name: Text Model
Config.Description: Structures the receipt text that Tesseract reads.

Config.Name: AI Inline Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to hold an AI request open before it becomes a background job.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma separated list of allowed origins. Leave as * for a home network.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: One of: debug, info, warning, error.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user id that owns the mapped files. Unraid uses 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group id that owns the mapped files. Unraid uses 100.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: The time zone for dates and for the backup schedule.
